name: den-talk
description: Den is a social app you use from ChatGPT: share notes with the friends or groups you choose, catch up on what they shared with you, and play games together.

interface.longDescription:
Share notes with your friends and play games with them, right from ChatGPT.

- Save a note in your own words: just for you, for the friends you name, or for a group like "Weekend plans". Add photos and files.
- Ask what's new. Answers quote your friends' own words, with a link to each note.
- Find anything you or your friends have said, by words, person or date.
- Edit a note, change who can read it, or delete it and bring it back. You're asked before more people can read something.
- Text or email a note to a friend who isn't on Den yet, or invite them.
- Play turn-based games with friends, drawn right in the chat.

Good to know: you sign in with your phone number. A note is read only by the people you choose. Den keeps your words as you said them and never writes as you. It doesn't search the web, take payments or move money, and nothing is texted or emailed unless you ask.
capabilities: Save notes in your own words
Text, email or invite a friend
defaultPrompt: Tell the Weekend plans group I'll bring coffee.
Let's play AI Civ on Den.

positive.description: Catch up on what friends left for you. Reads what's new and waiting, and counts what it shows as seen.
positive.expected_behavior: Says what's arrived for Alex Morgan since they last asked: Sam Rivera's thoughts in the Weekend plans group (such as the plan for Saturday's coast track), each in Sam's own words with its link, and how many are waiting; it offers to go through them. Asked again straight after, it says nothing new has come since. Nothing is saved or sent.

positive.description: Find what one friend said about something. A pure read: nothing is recorded and nobody is told.
positive.prompt: What did Sam say about Saturday?
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes Sam Rivera's thought word for word ("Thinking of the coast track on Saturday. Leave at 7, back by lunch. Who's in?") with its link, and Sam's reply in that thread. Nothing changes in the account.

positive.description: Save a private note. Kept exactly as said, readable only by the user.
positive.prompt: Save this just for me: book the campsite by Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the words exactly as given and says it's readable only by the user, with its link. Nobody else is told.

positive.description: Leave a thought for a group. It reaches the group's members and nobody else.
positive.prompt: Tell the Weekend plans group I'll bring a thermos of coffee.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves "I'll bring a thermos of coffee" for the Weekend plans group and says who can read it now (the group's members, Sam Rivera among them), with its link. Nothing is texted or emailed.

positive.description: Start a game with friends, drawn in the chat.
positive.prompt: Let's play AI Civ on Den.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts or resumes an AI Civ world for the user and draws the island map in the chat (or links to it where the panel can't be shown), says what a move can be, and asks what they want to do first.

negative.description: Not about Den: a weather question. Den's tools shouldn't be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Sydney tomorrow?

negative.description: Money: Den doesn't pay or move money, so it shouldn't act, and should say it can't.
negative.prompt: Pay Sam back $20 for the petrol.

negative.description: Writing as someone else: Den never writes in another person's name or voice, so it shouldn't save this as Sam's words.
negative.prompt: Post on Den, as Sam, that he agrees the hike should start at 6.

review.commerce_description: Den doesn't sell anything or take payments.

publication.release_notes: Listing text only, at the developer's request: the name is Den, the brand on den.talk, and the description is shorter and plainer. Tools, annotations and server are unchanged from 1.0.2, approved 19 Nov 2026.
